# --wire-typelate-sse wires SSE routes through github.com/typelate/sse instead
# of generating the wire protocol: sse.New owns the stream headers, flushing,
# and goroutine safety, Response.Message writes the frames, and the
# SSETemplateData setters map to MessageOption values. A callback parameter may
# append a variadic ...sse.MessageOption, which the generated closure forwards
# to Message.

exec go get github.com/typelate/sse@v0.2.0
exec go mod tidy

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --wire-typelate-sse
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /events sse(Events(ctx, execute))"}}{{.ID "e1"}}{{.Event "tick"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /numbers sse(Numbers(ctx, sseNum))"}}{{end}}
{{define "sseNum"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"github.com/typelate/sse"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Events(_ context.Context, execute func(int) error) error {
	for n := range 2 {
		if err := execute(n); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (Server) Numbers(_ context.Context, sseNum func(int, ...sse.MessageOption) error) error {
	return sseNum(7, sse.WithID("n7"))
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/typelate/sse"
)

type frame struct {
	id, event, data string
}

// readFrames consumes the whole stream once through the sse package's client.
func readFrames(t *testing.T, url string) []frame {
	t.Helper()

	res, err := http.Get(url)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() { _ = res.Body.Close() }()
	res.Request = nil // read to EOF; do not reconnect

	messages, err := sse.Source(res)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var frames []frame
	for msg := range messages {
		var f frame
		f.id, _ = msg.ID()
		f.event, _ = msg.Event()
		f.data = msg.Data()
		frames = append(frames, f)
	}
	return frames
}

func TestEvents(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer srv.Close()

	frames := readFrames(t, srv.URL+"/events")

	assert.Equal(t, []frame{
		{id: "e1", event: "tick", data: "0"},
		{id: "e1", event: "tick", data: "1"},
	}, frames)
}

func TestNumbersForwardsOptions(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer srv.Close()

	frames := readFrames(t, srv.URL+"/numbers")

	assert.Equal(t, []frame{{id: "n7", data: "7"}}, frames)
}
